title: Page 333
transc:
in our present undertaking there fore do not doubt
my courage have faith for even as you put
your faith in me so will I in you
Pekin and Wilkes hath said revenge is mine zebra
My removal consumed the means you gave me when
we parted Pedlar take this as a gentle hint
to bring a good supply for money makes the
mare go now a days zodiac I do as
you desired and keep as secluded as a nun
Pekin which is not agreeable to me as you
have found out ere this Pedlar but any thing
to oblige you darling zebra If any thing should
happen Pekin as I trust there will not Pedlar
to prevent your coming to the city please let 
me know and I will join you as agreed
upon at the house of our mutual friend A
dash S zebra Dont let any thing discourage you
zodiac Believe me yours and yours only yoke Etta
P. S Annie who is acting the maid to perfection 
wishes to be remembered to her dear ahem Pekin
Sam zebra Au Revoir youth Etta virgin go in
